checks.title: Sign in with the demo SuperAdmin
checks.expect: The Dashboard opens; the top bar shows Demo Admin with a purple SuperAdmin badge.

checks.title: Wrong password is refused
checks.expect: An error message appears and you stay on the login page.
checks.auto: ApiTests › Login with wrong password is 401

checks.title: A protected URL needs a login
steps: Type http://localhost:5173/master/customers in the address bar
checks.expect: You are sent to /login.
checks.auto: e2e app.spec.ts › unauthenticated user is redirected to login

checks.title: Sign out ends the session
checks.expect: You land on /login again; the previous screen does not come back.
checks.auto: App.test.tsx › Sign out ends the session on the server

checks.title: The session survives the 15-minute access token
steps: Leave the tab open for more than 15 minutes
checks.expect: The screen loads without asking you to sign in (silent refresh).

checks.title: All-time totals
checks.expect: Tiles show Total revenue, Total orders, Customers (200), Products (100) and Low stock.
checks.auto: BusinessApiTests › Dashboard stats count this organization only

checks.title: Sales analytics section
checks.expect: Section 'Sales analytics' shows KPIs with % change, a revenue chart, orders by status, top products and top customers; each range reloads the figures.

checks.title: Link to full analytics
checks.expect: The Analytics screen opens at /analytics.

checks.title: Hidden for the User role
checks.expect: Only the five tiles show; there is no Sales analytics section.
checks.auto: DashboardPage.test.tsx › hides it; e2e screens.spec.ts › User role

checks.title: KPIs compare with the previous period
checks.expect: Revenue, Orders, Average order value and New customers each show ▲/▼ with a % vs the previous period (or 'No data for the previous period').

checks.title: Revenue chart hover and keyboard
steps: Click the chart, then press ← and →
checks.expect: A crosshair and a tooltip show the date, revenue and order count for each point.

checks.title: Range switch
checks.expect: The chart title becomes 'Revenue by month' and the table lists 12 months.
checks.auto: AnalyticsPage.test.tsx › reloads when the range changes; AnalyticsTests (API)

checks.title: Status breakdown and rankings
checks.expect: Orders by status shows Pending / Paid / Shipped / Cancelled with % shares; top products, customers, cities and categories are sorted by revenue.

checks.title: Phone layout
steps: Narrow the window to about 390 px (or use the browser's device mode)
checks.expect: No sideways scrolling; the range buttons span the width; cards stack.

checks.title: Blocked for the User role
checks.expect: 'No access' card; Analytics is not in the menu.
checks.auto: AnalyticsTests › Default rights allow Admin but not User

checks.title: Ask a business question
steps: Type 'What is my revenue by city?'
checks.expect: A plain-English answer appears (with the SQL hidden from the user).

checks.title: Follow-up question uses the conversation
checks.expect: The answer refers to the previous question.
checks.auto: ChatPanel.test.tsx › sends prior turns as history

checks.title: Cannot change data
checks.expect: The assistant refuses or answers without changing anything; Customers still lists 200.

checks.title: List
checks.expect: 25 rows with Name, Email, City, Country; missing values show —.

checks.title: Delete with confirmation (SuperAdmin/Admin)
steps: Click Delete on a customer you created for testing
Cancel, then Delete again and confirm
checks.expect: Cancel changes nothing; confirming removes the row.
checks.auto: DataPages.test.tsx › deletes after confirmation; BusinessApiTests › Customers

checks.title: User role cannot delete
checks.expect: The list shows but there is no Delete column.
checks.auto: e2e screens.spec.ts › can read Customers but sees no Delete button

checks.title: List with prices and stock
checks.expect: SKU, Name, Category, Price in ₹ and Stock for 25 products.

checks.title: Delete
steps: Delete a test product and confirm
checks.expect: The row disappears and the list reloads.
checks.auto: BusinessApiTests › Products create update list by category and delete

checks.title: Latest orders
steps: Open Sales & Labour Work › Orders › Sales Orders
checks.expect: 25 newest orders with Date, Status, Items count and Total.
checks.auto: DataPages.test.tsx › Orders screen; BusinessApiTests › Orders list is newest first

checks.title: Business rules (API)
checks.expect: All pass: stock is reduced, overselling is refused, status goes Pending → Paid → Shipped only.

checks.title: Add a user
steps: Fill Full name, Email, Password (8+ chars)
checks.expect: The new user appears in the table; the form clears.
checks.auto: MasterPages.test.tsx › creates a user; e2e screens.spec.ts › Users

checks.title: Change role
steps: Change the new user's role to Admin
checks.expect: The role is saved; that user is signed out everywhere.

checks.title: Cannot manage yourself or higher roles
steps: Look at your own row (Demo Admin)
checks.expect: No role picker and no Delete button on your own row.
checks.auto: MasterPages.test.tsx › only manageable users get a role picker

checks.title: Delete the test user
steps: Click Delete on the user you created and confirm
checks.expect: The row disappears.
checks.auto: BusinessApiTests › Delete user removes them and their sessions

checks.title: Pick a user
steps: Choose Staff (User) in the User list
checks.expect: The rights matrix loads; rows without overrides say 'Default (role default)'.

checks.title: Override and restrict
steps: Tick Delete on Customers, click Save
Sign in as staff in another browser and open Customers
Back as admin, tick Restricted on Customers and Save
checks.expect: Staff sees Delete after the first save; after Restricted, Customers disappears from their menu and returns No access.
checks.auto: MasterTests › User override grants and restrict blocks immediately

checks.title: Reset to the role default
steps: Click 'Use role default' on the changed row and Save
checks.expect: The row goes back to the role default.

checks.title: Role defaults
steps: Open Role Rights (User role is selected)
checks.expect: Each role shows its matrix; SuperAdmin can edit Admin and User defaults.

checks.title: Grant Analytics to every User
steps: Tick Visible and Read on Analytics, Save
checks.expect: Staff now sees Analytics in the menu and the Sales analytics section on the Dashboard. Untick to undo.
checks.auto: MasterTests › Role defaults are per organization

checks.title: Page catalog
checks.expect: Every screen with module, group, key and route; Analytics shows Ready; Vendors shows Coming soon.
checks.auto: MasterPages.test.tsx › Pages screen; BusinessApiTests › Pages master

checks.title: Three-level menu
checks.expect: A 'Coming soon' card with the breadcrumb Inventory › Stock Position › Stock Position.

checks.title: Mobile drawer
checks.expect: The menu slides in, and closes after you pick a page (or press Escape / tap outside).
